name: Passage
source:
A short game exploring identity and self.  

When you are transported to a new world who are you? Would you choose to stay the same? 

[From [url=https://dotagotchi.itch.io/passage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
探索身份和自我的短游戏。

当你穿越到一个新世界时，你是谁？你会选择保持不变吗？

[来自[url=https://dotagotchi.itch.io/passage]Itch.io[/url]]
